items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Rene said... he's all right. So we said okay. We got set up and that night when we went to record Butchie didn't come

ctx.x: Well anyway, we go in and are going to do a session, several numbers and Rene said to me, I do so much recording around here, I think it would be better if you use your man, so it would be a different sound, you know, it won't be the same thing, and he said I heard Butch and everything and he's all right.
So we said okay. We got set up and that night when we went to record Butchie didn't come because he was drinking.
But as it turned out, old "Shoe Sole"--Hunter Gray was around the corner--
